panels.title: Daily Return
panels.description: UTC 일자 시작 총자산 대비 현재 총자산. 수수료·세금 포함.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.captured_at AS time, v.value::double precision AS value, p.display_name || ' · ' || v.metric AS metric FROM paper_portfolio_snapshots s JOIN paper_portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = s.portfolio_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('평가금액', s.equity), ('손익', s.equity - p.initial_cash), ('실현손익', s.realized_pnl), ('미실현손익', s.unrealized_pnl)) v(metric, value) WHERE s.portfolio_id IN ('rule', 'hermes') AND $__timeFilter(s.captured_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Rule vs Hermes 평가금액 · 손익
panels.description: 총자산=비용 반영 현금+평가. 손익=총자산-시작현금. 실현/미실현은 이동평균 원가.

targets.rawSql: WITH traded AS (SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM paper_fills WHERE portfolio_id = 'rule' AND $__timeFilter(executed_at) AND symbol IN (${trade_symbol:sqlstring})), candles AS (SELECT timestamp AS time, symbol, close_price, FIRST_VALUE(close_price) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY timestamp) AS base_price FROM market_candles WHERE interval = '1m' AND symbol IN (SELECT symbol FROM traded) AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)) SELECT c.time, (((c.close_price / NULLIF(c.base_price, 0)) - 1) * 100)::double precision AS value, COALESCE(s.display_name || ' (' || c.symbol || ')', c.symbol) AS metric FROM candles c LEFT JOIN market_symbols s ON s.symbol = c.symbol ORDER BY c.time

WITH traded AS (SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM paper_fills WHERE portfolio_id = 'rule' AND $__timeFilter(executed_at) AND symbol IN (${trade_symbol:sqlstring})), bases AS (SELECT symbol, (ARRAY_AGG(close_price ORDER BY timestamp))[1] AS base_price FROM market_candles WHERE interval = '1m' AND symbol IN (SELECT symbol FROM traded) AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY symbol) SELECT f.executed_at AS time, (((f.price / NULLIF(b.base_price, 0)) - 1) * 100)::double precision AS value, COALESCE(s.display_name || ' (' || f.symbol || ')', f.symbol) || ' · ' || f.side AS metric FROM paper_fills f JOIN bases b ON b.symbol = f.symbol LEFT JOIN market_symbols s ON s.symbol = f.symbol WHERE f.portfolio_id = 'rule' AND f.symbol IN (SELECT symbol FROM traded) AND $__timeFilter(f.executed_at) ORDER BY f.executed_at

panels.title: Rule Trades (1m)
panels.description: 이 포트폴리오가 기간 내 체결한 종목만. 선=1분 등락률, 점=BUY/SELL.

targets.rawSql: WITH traded AS (SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM paper_fills WHERE portfolio_id = 'hermes' AND $__timeFilter(executed_at) AND symbol IN (${trade_symbol:sqlstring})), candles AS (SELECT timestamp AS time, symbol, close_price, FIRST_VALUE(close_price) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY timestamp) AS base_price FROM market_candles WHERE interval = '1m' AND symbol IN (SELECT symbol FROM traded) AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)) SELECT c.time, (((c.close_price / NULLIF(c.base_price, 0)) - 1) * 100)::double precision AS value, COALESCE(s.display_name || ' (' || c.symbol || ')', c.symbol) AS metric FROM candles c LEFT JOIN market_symbols s ON s.symbol = c.symbol ORDER BY c.time

WITH traded AS (SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM paper_fills WHERE portfolio_id = 'hermes' AND $__timeFilter(executed_at) AND symbol IN (${trade_symbol:sqlstring})), bases AS (SELECT symbol, (ARRAY_AGG(close_price ORDER BY timestamp))[1] AS base_price FROM market_candles WHERE interval = '1m' AND symbol IN (SELECT symbol FROM traded) AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY symbol) SELECT f.executed_at AS time, (((f.price / NULLIF(b.base_price, 0)) - 1) * 100)::double precision AS value, COALESCE(s.display_name || ' (' || f.symbol || ')', f.symbol) || ' · ' || f.side AS metric FROM paper_fills f JOIN bases b ON b.symbol = f.symbol LEFT JOIN market_symbols s ON s.symbol = f.symbol WHERE f.portfolio_id = 'hermes' AND f.symbol IN (SELECT symbol FROM traded) AND $__timeFilter(f.executed_at) ORDER BY f.executed_at

panels.title: Hermes Trades (1m)
panels.description: 이 포트폴리오가 기간 내 체결한 종목만. 선=1분 등락률, 점=BUY/SELL.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pf.display_name || ' · ' || COALESCE(s.display_name || ' (' || p.symbol || ')', p.symbol) AS security, p.quantity::double precision AS quantity FROM (SELECT portfolio_id, symbol, SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'BUY' THEN quantity ELSE -quantity END) AS quantity FROM paper_fills WHERE portfolio_id IN ('rule', 'hermes') GROUP BY portfolio_id, symbol) p JOIN paper_portfolios pf ON pf.portfolio_id = p.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN market_symbols s ON s.symbol = p.symbol WHERE p.quantity <> 0 ORDER BY security

WITH RECURSIVE ordered AS (SELECT f.fill_id, f.portfolio_id, f.symbol, f.side, f.quantity, f.price, f.notional, COALESCE(f.commission, 0) AS commission, COALESCE(f.tax, 0) AS tax, f.reason, f.signal_id, f.executed_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.portfolio_id, f.symbol ORDER BY f.executed_at, f.fill_sequence) AS step FROM paper_fills f), walk AS (SELECT fill_id, portfolio_id, symbol, side, quantity, price, notional, commission, tax, reason, signal_id, executed_at, step, CASE WHEN side = 'BUY' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END AS held, CASE WHEN side = 'BUY' THEN notional + commission + tax ELSE 0 END AS basis, CASE WHEN side = 'BUY' THEN executed_at END AS opened_after, NULL::numeric AS avg_cost, NULL::timestamptz AS opened_at, NULL::numeric AS realized_pnl FROM ordered WHERE step = 1 UNION ALL SELECT n.fill_id, n.portfolio_id, n.symbol, n.side, n.quantity, n.price, n.notional, n.commission, n.tax, n.reason, n.signal_id, n.executed_at, n.step, CASE WHEN n.side = 'BUY' THEN w.held + n.quantity ELSE w.held - n.quantity END, CASE WHEN n.side = 'BUY' THEN w.basis + n.notional + n.commission + n.tax WHEN w.held - n.quantity = 0 THEN 0 ELSE w.basis - (w.basis * n.quantity / NULLIF(w.held, 0)) END, CASE WHEN n.side = 'BUY' AND w.held = 0 THEN n.executed_at WHEN n.side = 'SELL' AND w.held - n.quantity = 0 THEN NULL ELSE w.opened_after END, CASE WHEN n.side = 'SELL' THEN w.basis / NULLIF(w.held, 0) END, CASE WHEN n.side = 'SELL' THEN w.opened_after END, CASE WHEN n.side = 'SELL' THEN n.notional - n.commission - n.tax - (w.basis * n.quantity / NULLIF(w.held, 0)) END FROM walk w JOIN ordered n ON n.portfolio_id = w.portfolio_id AND n.symbol = w.symbol AND n.step = w.step + 1) SELECT w.executed_at AS time, COALESCE(p.display_name, w.portfolio_id) AS portfolio, COALESCE(s.display_name || ' (' || w.symbol || ')', w.symbol) AS security, w.side, w.quantity, w.price, w.notional, w.commission AS "수수료", w.tax AS "세금", w.avg_cost AS "평균원가", w.opened_at AS "매수시각", w.realized_pnl AS "실현손익", w.reason, w.signal_id, w.fill_id FROM walk w LEFT JOIN paper_portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = w.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN market_symbols s ON s.symbol = w.symbol WHERE $__timeFilter(w.executed_at) ORDER BY w.executed_at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Recent Paper Fills
panels.description: SELL은 이동평균 원가·포지션 첫 매수시각·해당 매도 실현손익. 수수료·세금 포함.

targets.rawSql: SELECT d.evaluated_at AS time, COALESCE(p.display_name, d.portfolio_id) AS portfolio, COALESCE(s.display_name || ' (' || d.symbol || ')', d.symbol) AS security, d.side, d.notional, d.approved, COALESCE(NULLIF((SELECT string_agg(value, ', ') FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(d.violations) AS value), ''), '승인') AS "판단 근거", d.available_cash, d.position_notional, d.daily_return_rate, d.consecutive_api_errors, d.signal_reason AS signal_reason, d.signal_id, d.decision_id FROM paper_risk_decisions d LEFT JOIN paper_portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = d.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN market_symbols s ON s.symbol = d.symbol WHERE $__timeFilter(d.evaluated_at) ORDER BY d.evaluated_at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Recent RiskManager Decisions
panels.description: 한도 거부는 여기만. Hermes token 행 없음.

targets.rawSql: WITH candles AS (SELECT timestamp AS time, symbol, close_price, FIRST_VALUE(close_price) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY timestamp) AS base_price FROM market_candles WHERE interval = '1m' AND symbol IN (${trade_symbol:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)) SELECT c.time, (((c.close_price / NULLIF(c.base_price, 0)) - 1) * 100)::double precision AS value, COALESCE(s.display_name || ' (' || c.symbol || ')', c.symbol) AS metric FROM candles c LEFT JOIN market_symbols s ON s.symbol = c.symbol ORDER BY c.time

WITH bases AS (SELECT symbol, (ARRAY_AGG(close_price ORDER BY timestamp))[1] AS base_price FROM market_candles WHERE interval = '1m' AND symbol IN (${trade_symbol:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY symbol) SELECT f.executed_at AS time, (((f.price / NULLIF(b.base_price, 0)) - 1) * 100)::double precision AS value, COALESCE(s.display_name || ' (' || f.symbol || ')', f.symbol) || ' · ' || COALESCE(p.display_name, f.portfolio_id) || ' ' || f.side AS metric FROM paper_fills f JOIN bases b ON b.symbol = f.symbol LEFT JOIN market_symbols s ON s.symbol = f.symbol LEFT JOIN paper_portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = f.portfolio_id WHERE f.symbol IN (${trade_symbol:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(f.executed_at) ORDER BY f.executed_at

SELECT d.evaluated_at AS time, COALESCE(s.display_name || ' (' || d.symbol || ')', d.symbol) AS security, d.score, d.amount_rank, d.gainer_rank, d.eligible_rank, d.change_rate, d.trading_amount, d.reference_price, d.risk_approved, d.selected, d.violations::text AS violations, r.status AS refresh_status, d.run_id FROM dynamic_universe_decisions d JOIN dynamic_universe_runs r ON r.run_id = d.run_id LEFT JOIN market_symbols s ON s.symbol = d.symbol WHERE $__timeFilter(d.evaluated_at) ORDER BY d.evaluated_at DESC, d.eligible_rank NULLS LAST, d.amount_rank, d.symbol LIMIT 500
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(finished_at, '1d'), SUM(prompt_tokens) AS prompt, SUM(completion_tokens) AS completion FROM automation_run_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(finished_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT finished_at AS time, run_type, status, stage, duration_ms, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, error, run_id FROM automation_run_logs WHERE run_type IN ('hermes_trade', 'market_scan', 'daily') AND $__timeFilter(finished_at) ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Hermes Automation Run Log
panels.description: 실제 advisor 호출만. 한도 preflight 거부 없음.

targets.rawSql: SELECT finished_at AS time, details->>'workflowId' AS workflow, details->>'executionId' AS execution_id, stage, status, duration_ms, details->>'portfolioId' AS portfolio, details->>'interval' AS interval, details->>'symbols' AS symbols, details->>'signals' AS signals, details->>'fills' AS fills, details->>'failed' AS failed, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, details->>'telegramAccepted' AS telegram_accepted, details->>'riskDecisionIds' AS risk_decision_ids, error, run_id FROM automation_run_logs WHERE run_type = 'n8n_flow' AND $__timeFilter(finished_at) ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT r.started_at AS time, v.value::double precision AS value, p.display_name || ' · ' || v.metric AS metric FROM paper_cycle_runs r JOIN paper_portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = r.portfolio_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('Symbols', r.symbol_count), ('Signals', r.signal_count), ('Fills', r.fill_count), ('Failures', r.failed_count), ('API Errors', r.consecutive_api_errors)) v(metric, value) WHERE r.portfolio_id IN ('rule', 'hermes') AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) ORDER BY 1

list.label: 종목 범위
list.name: trade_filter
list.query: 체결 종목만 : traded, 전체 조회 종목 : all

list.definition: SELECT COALESCE(s.display_name || ' (' || c.symbol || ')', c.symbol) AS __text, c.symbol AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM market_candles WHERE interval = '1m') c LEFT JOIN market_symbols s ON s.symbol = c.symbol WHERE '${trade_filter}' = 'all' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM paper_fills f WHERE f.symbol = c.symbol) ORDER BY __text
list.label: 종목
list.name: trade_symbol
list.query: SELECT COALESCE(s.display_name || ' (' || c.symbol || ')', c.symbol) AS __text, c.symbol AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM market_candles WHERE interval = '1m') c LEFT JOIN market_symbols s ON s.symbol = c.symbol WHERE '${trade_filter}' = 'all' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM paper_fills f WHERE f.symbol = c.symbol) ORDER BY __text
